report.text:
## Where the papers agree
Adding dropout increased the test accuracy of ResNet-50 on CIFAR-10. [p19b5cd3186_c1] [pa5849cf417_c1]

## Where the papers conflict
"Adding dropout increased the test accuracy of ResNet-50 on CIFAR-10" conflicts with "Adding dropout decreased the test accuracy of ResNet-50 on CIFAR-10" (The stated conditions match). [p19b5cd3186_c1] [p90a897f383_c1]
"Adding dropout decreased the test accuracy of ResNet-50 on CIFAR-10" conflicts with "Adding dropout increased the test accuracy of ResNet-50 on CIFAR-10" (The stated conditions match). [p90a897f383_c1] [pa5849cf417_c1]

## Where the settings differ
"Adding dropout increased the test accuracy of ResNet-50 on CIFAR-10" and "Adding dropout decreases test accuracy of ResNet-50 on ImageNet" were measured differently (dataset: CIFAR-10 in the first, ImageNet in the second). [p19b5cd3186_c1] [peb54c2fcdd_c1]
"Adding dropout increased the test accuracy of ResNet-50 on CIFAR-10" and "Adding dropout decreases test accuracy of ResNet-50 on ImageNet" were measured differently (dataset: CIFAR-10 in the first, ImageNet in the second). [pa5849cf417_c1] [peb54c2fcdd_c1]

## Still unclear
"Adding dropout decreased the test accuracy of ResNet-50 on CIFAR-10" cannot yet be compared with "Adding dropout decreases test accuracy of ResNet-50 on ImageNet". [p90a897f383_c1] [peb54c2fcdd_c1]
